title: fix(mcp): delete_record treats a request naming one matching record as the approval
body:
Fixes #34340

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #34456 — skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md (the delete_record row of the MCP tools table still says "ask the human first, then retry")

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:MCP `delete_record` 的工具说明、`confirm` 参数说明、同一服务器下发的技能文本(`GET /api/v1/mcp/skill`,及控制台"下载技能"的逐字副本)、拒绝提示和 `connect-mcp` 文档现在说同一条规则:用户点名要删的记录且恰好匹配一条,这句请求就是确认,agent 直接带 `confirm: true` 删(业务记录进回收站);名字匹配多条、没指明哪一条或是批量删除,先问用户。
- 为什么改:落实 #34340 卡上引用的维护者裁决「点名单条就算确认」;旧文案"先问人再重试"让各模型对点名单删读法不一,评测里 121 次失败写操作有 76 次卡在这条冲突上;同一服务器的技能文本和拒绝提示若仍说"先问",就是两套说法。
- 风险与回滚:只改文字,门禁不动(不带 `confirm: true` 仍被拒,428 `ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`,`details` 不变),批量 `delete_records` 不变;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts`(两句规则提为模块级导出、`recordDeleteConfirmationRefusal` 新提示);`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`(`delete_record` 条目插值两句、两处"确认"限定);`packages/mcp/src/mcp-delete-record-confirmation.test.ts`(技能文本与拒绝提示两处钉子)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/mcp exec vitest run src/mcp-delete-record-confirmation.test.ts`,预期 12 个用例全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The `delete_record` rule is two sentences, now module-level exports of `packages/mcp/src/mcp-http-tools.ts` (`DELETE_NAMED_RECORD_IS_APPROVAL`, `DELETE_AMBIGUOUS_ASKS_FIRST`; not re-exported from the package index, so the public surface is unchanged):

- "A request in which the human names the record to delete, with exactly one record matching, is the human's approval of that delete: send confirm: true on that call, without asking again."
- "When the name matches more than one record, or the request does not identify one record, do not delete yet: list the candidates, ask the human which one, and send confirm: true only after the answer."

Every text the MCP server gives an agent about `delete_record` now says that rule:

- **The tool description and the `confirm` member** carry both sentences (unchanged from r0, now read from the exports). The description drops "ask the human first, then retry" and keeps the gate sentence, the recycle-bin fact and the `recycleBinEntryId` sentence.
- **The served skill** (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`, `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill`): the `delete_record` entry interpolates the two exports in place of "Ask your human first; the flag asserts an approval, it does not obtain one." The destructive-action gotcha now reads "Confirm destructive actions (`delete_record`, bulk updates) with the user; a `delete_record` the user named, with exactly one record matching, is already confirmed.", and the workflow step reads "confirming destructive steps with the user (a delete the user named, with exactly one record matching, is already confirmed)."
- **The Console's skill download** (`ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.ts`) is the served skill's byte-identical, import-free copy; the drift pins on both sides (`packages/mcp/src/skill-md.test.ts`, `objectstack-skill.test.ts`) hold it equal, so it takes the same text. The changeset adds `'@object-ui/console': patch` for it.
- **The refusal of an unconfirmed `delete_record` call** (`recordDeleteConfirmationRefusal`) now says: "Deleting is destructive even where the recycle bin keeps the record. When the human's request named exactly this one record, that request is the approval: retry this call with 'confirm': true on the request. When the name matched more than one record, or the request is a bulk delete, ask the human first, then retry." This is a text change under the maintainer's ruling 「点名单条就算确认」 quoted on #34340 (routed by the seat, claim amendment on the card); no new decision is needed. The code (`ACTION_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED`), status (428), `details` and the gate itself are unchanged.
- **The docs** (`content/docs/ai/connect-mcp.mdx`, the `delete_record` paragraph) state the same rule, and no longer call the delete "permanent": a deleted business record goes to the recycle bin until the deployment's retention ends (30 days by default); a record of a platform object (`sys_`, `cloud_`, `ai_`), or any record on a deployment with no recycle bin, is deleted permanently, in the wording of the tool's recycle-bin sentence.

Unchanged: the gate, `delete_records` (bulk, preview first, its refusal and texts), spec, ADRs and `skills/**`.

## Tests

`packages/mcp/src/mcp-delete-record-confirmation.test.ts` is the existing harness for this tool; the pins stay in it:

- r0 describe "a request naming one matching record is the approval; ambiguity asks first": both sentences verbatim on the description and the `confirm` member; control: `delete_records` carries neither and still says preview.
- **new in r1, same describe**: the skill the same server serves (`MCPServerRuntime.renderSkill()`, what `GET /api/v1/mcp/skill` answers) carries both sentences.
- **new in r1, existing refusal test** ("refuses a call without the member"): beside `code`, `status`, `details` and the engine's `delete` never called, the message carries the retry-or-ask rule.
- No other test, dogfood test included, asserts the old refusal text (`git grep` for "confirm with the human" / "human in the loop, then retry": the only other hits are `run_action`'s own runtime refusal and its double in this file, both untouched).

Ablations (one-time, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, source import with no dist path, each under a `trap` restore and a HEAD-blob check; no permanent file):

- M1, `skill-md.ts`: anchor `  ${DELETE_NAMED_RECORD_IS_APPROVAL}` replaced by a marker, anchor 1 -> 0, blob `15da3d35bb0e` -> `891e77a46003`; the pin file went red (`Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, "the skill the same server serves ... carries both sentences": expected the skill to contain "A request in which the human names th..."); restored to the HEAD blob `15da3d35bb0e`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- N1, `mcp-http-tools.ts`: the refusal's "that request is the" clause replaced by the old "confirm with the human in the loop, then" wording plus a marker, anchor 1 -> 0, blob `1cc59f6af811` -> `11418cb7abdc`; red (`Tests 1 failed | 11 passed (12)`, "refuses a call without the member": expected the message to contain "When the human's request named exact..."); restored to the HEAD blob `1cc59f6af811`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/objectstack-ai/SKILL.md` line 202 is not edited here: implementation-card file surfaces exclude `skills/**`, which gets its own `domain:skills` card (and `dispatch-gates --tier` mandates a higher model tier for that path). The follow-up is #34456.
- `CHANGELOG.md` entries that quote the old description are release-owned and stay.
- The Console mirror file was outside the r1 claim amendment's list; it is edited because the drift pins require the copy to equal the served skill byte for byte, and a served-skill change without it reds Test Core.
